description: Golf booking workflow: After booking Saturday successfully, user requested override to Sunday 1 PM. Workflow was reset to re-run with new target. However, cancellation of Saturday booking (2M0G-8C0F) was NOT performed by the workflow — user had to click Cancel manually.
correction: When override_instructions redirect to a different date/time, the workflow should include a cancellation step BEFORE resetting to book the new target. The workflow should: (1) Verify existing booking exists, (2) Navigate to Bookings page, (3) Find and click Cancel, (4) Wait for confirmation, (5) THEN reset state to re-run with new target.
systemic_fix: Add cancellation protocol to golf-booking workflow: new step or branch in step-06/07 that detects override_instructions pointing to different date and executes cancellation before state reset. Make cancellation idempotent (safe to call even if no prior booking exists).

resolution.action: Applied in build work-20260917-234104: new step workflows/golf-booking/steps/step-00-cancel-prior-booking.md detects when override_instructions (or the top-ranked target) point to a date/time different from the booking recorded in state.yaml, and executes the cancellation BEFORE state is reset to book the new target. Cancellation is idempotent: no booking-id in state, or the prior booking already absent from the Bookings page, is a logged no-op. Safety ordering: if the new target is outside the 8-day booking window, cancellation is deferred (pending-cancellation recorded in accumulated-context, prior booking retained) so David is never left without a booking while the replacement is unbookable. Wired into workflow.md as Gate 0 in the step table, QUALITY GATE SUMMARY, and FAILURE MODES; STATE CHECK now mandates step-00 runs first on every fresh run.
resolution.acceptance_test_result: Protocol-level fix (workflow step), not executable code — validated by structural wiring review: Gate 0 present in all three workflow.md tables, step-00 executes before step-01, state reset happens only after a DOM-verified cancellation.
